figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Product analysis of GTC2 with FPP and GGPP. (A) Total ion chro­
matograms (TICs) of the enzymatic assays of GTC2 analyzed by gas chroma­
tography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). The GC–MS program runs for 35 min, 
including a 5-min solvent delay, and only the product-containing region of the 
chromatogram is shown. (i) GTC2 incubated with FPP in vitro; (ii) E. coli chassis 
heterologously expressing GTC2 together with a FPP synthase. (iii) GTC2 
incubated with GGPP in vitro; (iv) E. coli chassis heterologously expressing 
GTC2 together with a GGPP synthase. (v) E. coli chassis heterologously 
expressing GGPP synthase, used as a control. GGOH denotes geranylgeraniol. 
(B) Chemical structures of the isolated products 1–8. (C) Structure elucidation 
of compound 8 showing key NMR correlations. Bold lines indicate key 1H–1H 
COSY correlations; single-headed arrows indicate key HMBC correlations; 
double-headed arrows indicate key NOESY correlations.

figure_candidates.label: Scheme 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Scheme 1. Proposed cyclization mechanism of GTC2 with GGPP. (A) Plausible 
cyclization pathway leading to products 5–8. (B) Proposed in vivo biosynthetic 
pathway leading to product 8.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Product analysis of E2E2 with FPP and GGPP. (A) TICs of the enzymatic 
assays of E2E2 analyzed by GC–MS. The GC–MS program runs for 35 min, 
including a 5-min solvent delay, and only the product-containing region of the 
chromatogram is shown. (i) E2E2 incubated with FPP in vitro; (ii) E2E2 incu­
bated with GGPP in vitro; (iii) E. coli chassis heterologously expressing E2E2 
together with a GGPP synthase. (B) Chemical structures of the isolated products 
9 and 10, and key NMR correlations of compound 9 together with the two 
proposed isomers (A1 and B1) used for NMR calculations. Bold lines indicate 
key 1H–1H COSY correlations; single-headed arrows indicate key HMBC cor­
relations; double-headed arrows indicate key NOESY correlations.
